summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim consolidated financial statements for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, corporate action, or solicitation is disclosed. Reported revenue was US$10,599 million in the quarter versus US$10,420 million a year earlier, gross profit fell to US$2,659 million from US$3,788 million, and net income attributable to Vale shareholders was US$1,255 million, or US$0.29 per share, against US$2,685 million and US$0.63. Nine-month operating cash flow was US$6,810 million; financing outflows included US$4,421 million of dividends and interest on capital. No deal terms, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock appear. What to watch is ordinary earnings, cash-return, and Brumadinho/Samarco liability trends, not event-driven arbitrage.
